waive.TypeOK: Shape check only: no behaviour change breaks it without also breaking a property above it, and TLC already stops with an evaluation error when an action leaves a variable unspecified.

mutations.name: microtask-await-treated-as-yield
mutations.why: The await is modeled as able to yield although the code only waits on an already-resolved promise: the model grows an interleaving the event loop cannot produce, so the lost update it reports is a false counterexample. Here it shows that NoLostUpdate does notice a yield.

mutations.name: macrotask-runs-inside-a-turn
mutations.why: Start no longer waits for an idle loop: a second handler begins while the first is between its two writes.

mutations.name: drop-ledger-write
mutations.why: The synchronous tail forgets its second write: the pair stays torn after the turn ends.

mutations.name: remove-fairness
mutations.why: Without WF on Step a task may stop forever before it finishes, so AllFinish must fail by stuttering.
